about: Vetted licence texts for distributions whose wheel ships none (plan D4). scripts/bundle_licenses.py copies <distribution>/<version>/<file> into the output's licence-texts/ and cites it in licenses.json. An entry names the version it was vetted against; when the shipped version differs the override is not applied and the packager's verify fails until the text is re-vetted at the new version.

ctranslate2.evidence: repository LICENSE at the tag; python/setup.py at the tag declares license="MIT"; no sdist on PyPI

fal-client.evidence: monorepo-root LICENSE at the tag covers projects/fal_client (the sdist's Project-URL repository); the sdist and its metadata carry no licence of their own, so none contradicts it
